meta.name: etetoolkit
meta.description: Analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic or other hierarchical trees with ETE 4. Use for Newick/Nexus tree I/O, topology edits and pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree evolutionary events and reconciliation, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, SmartView exploration, and publication rendering. Do not use it to infer trees from raw sequences; align sequences and infer a tree first.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析、比较与注释进化树
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果处理系统发育数据并需要比较树结构。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze, compare, and annotate phylogenetic trees.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with phylogenetic data and need to compare tree topologies.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以读取、修改、比较和绘制系统发育树等层级树文件，检测基因树中的复制/分化事件、寻找直系同源基因，查询 NCBI/GTDB 分类信息，并用 PDF、SVG 等格式输出图表。也能处理聚类树和热图。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理树文件、检测进化事件或绘制树图等树相关任务时触发。不用于从原始序列推断树。

say.text: 帮我把这个 Newick 树做中点根，并统计叶节点数。
say.note: 会完成中点根并输出统计。

say.text: 比较这两棵树的 Robinson-Foulds 距离，列出共有和独有的分裂。
say.note: 返回 RF 距离和分裂对比。

say.text: 给这个基因树检测复制/分化事件，并导出直系同源组。
say.note: 调用事件检测并输出分组文件。

howto.what_en: Claude can read, edit, compare, and render phylogenetic trees, detect duplication/speciation events and orthologs, query NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, and export PDF/SVG figures. Also handles clustering dendrograms and heatmaps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when users ask to process tree files, detect evolutionary events, or draw tree figures, among related tree tasks. Not for inferring trees from raw sequences.

say_en.text: Midpoint-root this Newick tree and count its leaf nodes.
Compare these two trees using Robinson-Foulds distance and list shared/unique splits.
say_en.note: Returns RF distance and partition details.

say_en.text: Detect duplication/speciation events in this gene tree and export orthogroups.
say_en.note: Runs event detection and writes group files.
